verdict.rationale: Commenting on items is a fair capability to expect from a work-management product like Asana, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents inline comments anchored to specific text or images within a task description. The only comment mentions are integration syncs (Slack, Bitbucket), which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can comment directly on specific text or images within an item's description
